CREATE TABLE workspace_model_configs (
	workspace_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	capability VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	protocol VARCHAR(40), 
	base_url VARCHAR(2048), 
	model VARCHAR(128), 
	encrypted_api_key TEXT, 
	updated_by_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, capability), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_model_config_capability CHECK (capability IN ('generation', 'embedding')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_model_config_mode CHECK (mode IN ('inherit', 'override')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_model_config_revision CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
